sources.title: GitHub - devansh0703/slm-foundry
sources.snippet: From-scratch SLM pretraining foundry: take raw text all the way to an Ollama-runnable chat model in one repo. A small (~15M-60M param) decoder-only LM with a modern speedrun-grade architecture (RoPE, RMSNorm, GQA, relu^2 MLP, QK-norm / sliding-window / softcap flags), trained with the Muon optimizer (orthogonalized-by-Newton-Schulz momentum) on hidden matrices plus AdamW on everything else ...
